prompt: Round 2 of 6. The company side proposes (Contract research is the right fit because we need a bounded answer within a year and our in-house capacity is limited

content.text:
The company wants contract_research_company_owns IP. My position requires university ownership. I need to change ip to uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence (appropriate for contract research where company needs to use results). Also, 60-day review is acceptable but I'd prefer 30 days given my active publication record. Let me change ip and reduce reviewDays to 30, trading on exclusivity acceptance.

Actually I can only change at most two fields. Let me change ip to company_owns_uni_academic_use (company owns but university keeps academic use rights - this is reasonable for contract research) and reviewDays to 30.

Wait - my notes say university ownership of results is my interest. 

Settling on uni_owns_option_to_licence for ip, giving the university ownership while letting the company license results, and reducing publication.reviewDays to 30 — my two field changes.
